codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the feature requirements: dashboard routes were registered for /api/admin/agents/{id}/resolved, /validate, and /diff; each route enforces method checks and returns JSON errors; resolved-contract retrieval, validation of proposed changes, and field-level diffing (global or other-agent base) are implemented with inheritance source annotations per changed field. Test coverage includes success and error cases for all three endpoints plus auth-gating regression checks for the new admin routes.
